title: Raku Firing October 10, 2026
evidence_sentence: A raku firing is scheduled for October 10, 2026, with 8 spots available at 10:30am–1:30pm and 12pm–3pm.
how_to_join: Sign up at the calendar link on the Raku Firing page
summary: Spokane Potters' Guild is holding a raku firing on October 10, 2026, with 8 spots available for each of two time slots. Participants must bring glazed pieces and be present to manage the reduction chamber.
